purpose: Calibrate paired playtest and judgment dispersion under a true A/A null, not estimate a treatment effect.
arm_b_requirement: Arm B must be independently executed with --plan-from e6-aa-a-calibration.
selection_rule: Using the current strictly certified corpus and its pre-existing contiguous strata, choose depth 3 for low, depth 5 for middle, and depth 8 for high; within each target depth choose the lexicographically first case ID. This rule was fixed before inference.

metric_definitions.solved: Objective solved indicator from the deterministic scorecard.
metric_definitions.correct: Objective correct-solution indicator from the deterministic scorecard.
metric_definitions.actions_or_censored_action_budget: Observed scored actions; out-of-budget runs are represented at the fixed action budget and marked right-censored; quit runs are marked right-censored at observed actions.
metric_definitions.hints_helped: Scorecard fraction of requested hints followed by progress within five actions; missing when no hint was requested.
metric_definitions.longest_stall: Longest scorecard run of at least 12 actions without progress, otherwise zero.
metric_definitions.fallback_or_decline_rate: Character fallbacks plus neutral declines divided by character turns; missing with zero character turns.
metric_definitions.witnessed_village_actions: Count of witnessed morning-village actions in the private trace.

analysis.blocking: Compute pair differences and weight each case equally through case-block means.
analysis.empirical_null: Exact within-pair sign flips of the equal-case blocked mean.
analysis.nominal_interval: 95% t interval over the three case means, reported only as a calibration descriptor.
analysis.missingness: Every planned pair remains in the denominator; differences require both arm values and all missing reasons are counted.
analysis.censoring: Out-of-budget and quit episodes remain in the denominator and are explicitly marked right-censored.
